# Support

Need help with SQLiteXM? Here's where to start.

## 📖 Documentation

Before asking for help, please check the
[SQLiteXM Documentation Guide](../blob/master/Docs/README.md) to find
the guide that best matches your question.

## 💬 Questions and troubleshooting

If you need help using SQLiteXM, have a configuration question, or are
having trouble with something that isn't working as expected, please use
[GitHub Discussions → Q&A](../discussions/categories/q-a).

Please search existing discussions before starting a new one.

When asking for help, include enough information for others to understand
the problem, including relevant code, error messages, SQLiteXM/.NET
versions, and your target platform when applicable.

## 💡 Ideas and feature requests

Have an idea for improving SQLiteXM? Please use
[GitHub Discussions → Ideas](../discussions/categories/ideas).

Please search existing ideas before creating a new discussion.

## 🐛 Bug reports

If you've found a reproducible bug in SQLiteXM, please open a
[GitHub Issue](../issues).

When reporting a bug, please include:

- What you expected to happen
- What actually happened
- Steps to reproduce the problem
- A minimal code example, when possible
- Relevant error messages or logs
- SQLiteXM, .NET, and .NET MAUI versions
- Target platform, when applicable

## 💬 General discussion

For topics that don't fit Q&A or Ideas, use
[GitHub Discussions → General](../discussions/categories/general).

Thank you for using SQLiteXM and helping make the project better!
